images.view: Cinematic three-quarter view from slightly above, with the whole station visible inside the frame, centred and filling most of it.
images.site: In space, in high orbit above a lifeless grey rocky planet whose curved horizon crosses the bottom of the frame, with stars in the black sky.
images.mood: Art direction: realistic sci-fi concept art, ominous mood, soft warm sunlight from the right with strong contrast, deep black space.
images.subject: A small pirate outpost: a small, modest pirate space station with a clear silhouette: a spoked ring around a central hub, built from mismatched scavenged modules, dark gunmetal and rust-brown patchwork plates, with dim orange-red lights; a single small ring, a few docked small fighters and one docking arm.
images.detail: It looks makeshift and lightly armed, with only two small gun turrets.

images.subject: A pirate lair: a medium pirate space station with a clear silhouette: a spoked ring around a central hub, built from mismatched scavenged modules, dark gunmetal and rust-brown patchwork plates, with dim orange-red lights, hidden among a few drifting small rocks, with several docking arms and a dozen docked fighters.
images.detail: It is armed with several gun turrets and has crude extra modules bolted onto its ring.

images.subject: A pirate fortress: a large heavily armoured pirate space station with a clear silhouette: two stacked spoked rings around a central hub, built from mismatched scavenged modules, dark gunmetal and rust-brown patchwork plates, with dim orange-red lights, bristling with heavy gun turrets and armour plates.
images.detail: Armed gunships are docked along its rings, and searchlights sweep from its hub.

images.subject: The black citadel, the pirates' greatest stronghold: a colossal pirate space station with a clear silhouette: three huge spoked rings around a central hub, built from mismatched scavenged modules, almost black armour plates, with dim orange-red lights, bristling with huge gun batteries and armour, with a tall central spire.
images.detail: Many warships are docked around it; its many small red lights glow menacingly in the dark.
